key_catalyst: Israel-Lebanon ceasefire plus Strait of Hormuz reopening triggering a risk-on rotation into equities
reasoning: Today's dominant catalysts are bullish and resolving rather than escalating: the Israel-Lebanon ceasefire and Strait of Hormuz reopening directly unwind the oil/inflation overhang that drove the bearish tone on 2026-07-15, 07-16 and 07-20, when Brent above $90 and a ninth day of US strikes on Iran were repeatedly cited as top-impact bearish items. The residual bearish item (glm-5.2's Iran risk, impact 4) is a recurring theme already absorbed by the market over three sessions, not a novel high-severity shock. Alphabet's report is a genuine two-sided event, but it lands tomorrow (07-22), so it is a next-session risk rather than a reason to exit today.
